\documentclass[varwidth=true,border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{circuitikz}

\begin{document}
\begin{circuitikz}
  % Adapted from the TeX Live circuitikz diode-family manual examples.
  \draw (0,0) to[zD*,l=$Z_{\mathrm{full}}$] (3,0);
  \draw (0,-1.6) to[zDo,diodes/fill=orange!30,l=$Z_{\mathrm{empty}}$] (3,-1.6);
  \draw (0,-3.2) to[zzD-,l=$ZZ_{\mathrm{sloped}}$] (3,-3.2);

  \ctikzset{diode straight whiskers}
  \draw (4,0) to[zzD*,l=$ZZ_{\mathrm{straight}}$] (7,0);
  \draw (4,-2) to[tvsDo,l=$\mathrm{TVS}_{\mathrm{straight}}$] (8,-2);
  \ctikzset{diode sloped whiskers}
  \draw (4,-4) to[tvsD*,diodes/scale=.75,l=$\mathrm{TVS}_{\mathrm{sloped}}$] (8,-4);
\end{circuitikz}
\end{document}
